evidence: P-02 reference 1 cites P-07 and shares Guan/Peltz/Co-Scientist authors.
P-07 Results 2.2 explicitly describes Co-Scientist-recommended targets and reports the experimental follow-up.
P-07 data availability lists GSE228214, GSE306096 and Zenodo 14996331; datasets not downloaded or compared here.
relationships.unresolved: Exact sample/batch overlap between reports is not established; do not double-count as independent efficacy confirmations.
relationships.denominators: P-02 summarizes 2 of 3 nominated epigenetic directions. P-07 describes 25-drug profiling and five inhibitors covering three AI-selected targets (including three BRD4 inhibitors). These are different counting units.

evidence: PubMed author lists include overlapping Rufo/Agostinis/Verhelst investigators.
relationships.unresolved: Potential probe/data lineage overlap was not audited; separate DOI is not a proof of independent experimental replication.
